01 — CASE STUDY OVERVIEW

KaizenQ: AI-Powered Learning Management System & SaaS Platform

How SHAIVIKA IT TECHNOLOGIES engineered an intelligent, scalable EdTech SaaS system combining interactive course management, automated multi-format assessments, student analytics, and an integrated real-time AI Mentor.

Product Type

EdTech SaaS Platform

Core Domain

AI Mentorship & LMS

Key Technologies

React, Node.js, LLMs, Postgres

Delivery Scope

Architecture, UI/UX & Full-Stack

01 — OVERVIEW

Reimagining Remote Education with AI-Native Guidance

KaizenQ was conceived as an intelligent learning environment designed to solve high drop-off rates in online education. While conventional LMS platforms provide static video repositories and generic multiple-choice quizzes, modern technical students require contextual code explanations, proactive feedback, and flexible self-paced tracking.

SHAIVIKA IT TECHNOLOGIES partnered with the KaizenQ product team to build a multi-role web platform from scratch — serving students, instructors, and organization admins on a high-throughput, secure cloud infrastructure.

02 — THE CHALLENGE

Bridging the Gap Between Self-Paced Learning and Interactive Tutoring

The core challenge was threefold:

  • •
    High Student Dropouts: When students got stuck on complex logic or algorithm questions, delayed instructor responses caused learning momentum to collapse.
  • •
    Manual Grading Bottlenecks: Instructors spent dozens of hours weekly manually evaluating coding submissions and open-ended technical assignments.
  • •
    Scalable Multi-Tenant Access: The platform required role-based permissions (Super Admin, Instructor, Student) with verifiable certificate verification.
03 — STRATEGY

An AI-First Architectural Foundation

Rather than bolting an ungrounded third-party chatbot onto a legacy forum, we designed a direct LLM-powered context pipeline. The AI Mentor was provided structured access to the current lecture's transcript, code snippets, and syllabus boundaries. This ensured responses remained strictly relevant, pedagogical, and prevented hallucinated answers.

04 — THE SOLUTION

A Modular, High-Performance LMS Architecture

We developed a unified platform consisting of:

✓ Interactive Course Engine: Video streaming, rich Markdown lectures, and chapter progression gates.
✓ Embedded AI Mentor: 24/7 contextual assistant that provides hints, code explanations, and debugging tips.
✓ Automated Assessments: Instant grading with automated error analysis and score breakdown.
✓ Verifiable Credentials: Cryptographically validated PDF certificates with public verification URLs.
✓ Instructor Dashboard: Cohort analytics, time-spent telemetry, and drop-off heatmaps.
✓ Admin Management: Role-based access control, billing tiers, and enrollment batch actions.
05 — TECHNOLOGY STACK

Engineered for Latency and Concurrency

React Vite Node.js Express.js PostgreSQL Google Gemini & LLM APIs Cloudinary Media Tailwind CSS JWT Security
06 — KEY FEATURES

Delivered Product Capabilities

Adaptive AI Mentor

Learners highlight any confusing paragraph or code segment to receive step-by-step Socratic explanations without leaving the lecture view.

Real-Time Student Analytics

Instructors monitor quiz completion times, lecture playback rates, and identifying struggling students before examinations.

Automated Certificate Engine

Auto-generates high-resolution PDF certificates upon 100% course and assessment completion with tamper-proof validation IDs.

Scalable Multi-Tenancy

Supports enterprise organizational partitions, allowing distinct corporate clients to host private academies within one core codebase.

07 — ARCHITECTURE & SCREENS

System Pipeline & Interface Layout

// KAIZENQ DISTRIBUTED SYSTEM TOPOLOGY
Client Layer: Responsive React SPA • Instant client-side state caching • Sub-100ms UI transitions.
API Gateway & Auth: Node.js Express cluster • JWT access tokens • Rate-limited AI proxy endpoints.
AI Vector Layer: Syllabus context chunking • LLM prompt templates • Safe pedagogical output filtering.
Persistence & Storage: Relational schema for courses, enrollments, and quiz logs • Cloudinary video CDN.

The platform successfully launched with end-to-end functionality delivered on schedule:

  • ✓ Instant 24/7 AI tutor answers without requiring human instructor intervention.
  • ✓ Automated quiz grading with instant remedial suggestions delivered immediately to the student.
  • ✓ Zero-maintenance serverless media streaming via integrated cloud asset pipelines.
  • ✓ Full compliance with modern web accessibility and responsive guidelines.
